claude_only.name: Does the address carry a governed global identifier or resolvable IRI in addition to the local register key, and is it persistent?
Which alternative, legacy or third-party identifiers are recorded, and to which system is each scoped?
Under which changes does the identifier stay stable, and which change compels minting a new one?
Within what scope is uniqueness enforced — single register, jurisdiction, country or globally?
Which address class does this record instantiate — numbered thoroughfare, landmark, postal delivery, or another declared class?
Which address specification or class profile governs this record, and at which version?
Does the record designate a location, a point of postal delivery, or both, and how is that role encoded?
How does this class map to the corresponding classes of each standard the register claims alignment with?
Which components scope this address, and what level does each occupy in the hierarchy?
Which components are mandatory, conditional or prohibited for this class in this country?
Does each component reference an authoritative external feature, or repeat a name as unlinked text?
How are sub-country administrative levels ordered and labelled, and how does that ordering survive exchange?
Which locator designators identify the object within its scope, and at which locator level does each apply?
Is the house number a plain ordinal, a range, a hyphenated compound or a non-numeric token, and how is it normalised for sorting and matching?
Which sub-address levels are addressable in their own right, and which are descriptive only?
When a sub-address exists, does it reference a parent address record or stand alone, and what breaks if the parent is retired?
Which address records are aliases of which primary address, and what is the alias relation type?
Which rendered or transliterated representations exist, and in which language and script is each written?
Which representation is authoritative for legal service of documents, and which for mail delivery?
May an alias be used as a matching key, and with what confidence penalty?
Which body holds the mandate to assign, alter and retire addresses here, and under what legal instrument?
Who stewards the address record, as distinct from whoever owns the object addressed?
What is the geographic extent of the authority's jurisdiction, and how are overlaps or gaps at its boundary resolved?
What status is given to an address created by a developer, occupier or crowd source rather than the authority?
Which numbering scheme governs this address, including axis origin, direction, interval, parity and block ranges?
What test determines that a candidate number is valid within the governing reference system?
How are numbers reserved, skipped or reissued when a parcel is subdivided or consolidated?
Where two schemes overlap the same ground, which one governs, and who decides?
What is the current lifecycle status of the address, and which transition produced it?
Which transitions are permitted, who may authorise each, and what evidence must accompany them?
Is a retired address retained for historical resolution, and for how long does it stay resolvable?
May an address be reserved or proposed before the object exists, and what obligations follow from that state?
How does official status differ from lifecycle status in this register, and can a record be active but unofficial?
When did the address become valid in the real world, and when did it cease to be valid?
When did this version of the record begin and end in the register, independent of real-world validity?
Are all recorded times expressed per RFC 3339 with seconds and an explicit offset or Z, and how is an unknown local offset represented?
How is a correction to a past record distinguished from a real-world change, and does a correction alter the validity period?
What is the observation or ingestion time of this version, and does it differ from the event time it reports?
Which addressable object does this address designate, in which sibling model, and by which identifier?
Can one object hold several addresses and one address designate several objects, and which combinations are legal here?
What basis justified the binding — building permit, survey, occupancy certificate or field observation?
What happens to the address when the object is demolished, merged or subdivided?
Is the binding exclusive for legal service, emergency dispatch and delivery alike, or may these differ?
Which identifier designates the thoroughfare independently of whatever name it currently bears?
How is the complete street name decomposed into pre-directional, pre-type, pre-modifier, base name, post-type, post-directional and post-modifier parts?
What is the addressing extent of the thoroughfare, and how does it link to the transport network feature that carries its geometry?
Which kinds of way are admissible as addressing thoroughfares in this jurisdiction, and which are excluded?
What renaming, splitting or merging events has this thoroughfare undergone, and when did each take effect?
For how long do superseded names remain acceptable for delivery, emergency dispatch and legal documents, and do those periods differ?
How are the addresses on the thoroughfare preserved or reissued across the change?
Which body approves a renaming, what consultation is required, and where is the decision recorded?
What postcode and post name apply, and which designated postal operator maintains them?
Is this a physical delivery point, a post office box, poste restante, a rural or highway contract route, or a military address?
Does the postal descriptor have a geographic extent, and is that extent authoritative or an approximation derived from delivery points?
May the postal city name differ from the municipality of location, and which is authoritative for which purpose?
How often does the operator revise postal codes, and how are revisions propagated to bound addresses?
Which country template governs rendering for this destination, at which version, and where is it obtained?
What line identification, ordering, concatenation and formatting rules apply, and which components are optional in each line?
Which contextual parameters change the rendering, such as origin country, domestic versus international, or script?
How are addressee and organisation segments kept separate from the location components this model owns?
What is done when a stored component has no mapping in the destination template?
What does this position represent — entrance, building, parcel, postal delivery point, utility connection or street segment interpolation?
By what method was the position determined, and by whom?
Which of several positions is the default, and which position should routing, dispatch and statistics each use?
In which geometry type and dimensionality is the position expressed, including any vertical or floor-level component?
What is the stated positional accuracy of this coordinate, under which measure and at what confidence level?
How many decimal places or code digits are meaningful here, and which published digits are spurious precision?
What test rejects a position falling outside the parcel, building footprint or jurisdiction it claims?
How is accuracy conveyed to a consumer whose format carries only a point without metadata?
In which coordinate reference system is this position expressed, cited by authority code and dataset version?
Is the CRS dynamic, and if so which coordinate epoch applies to the stored coordinates?
What axis order and units apply, and how is that reconciled with encodings that fix longitude before latitude?
Which coordinate operation, at what accuracy, is applied when transforming into a consumer's CRS?
Is a vertical or compound CRS declared for any height component, and what is its datum?
Which location types does this spatial reference system define, and what identifier form does each use?
How do location instances nest, adjoin or overlap, and which of those relationships are recorded?
Which gazetteer is custodian of record for each location type, and over what territory of use?
Does each location instance carry a complementary coordinate reference, and at what geometry level?
How are location instances added, merged, split and retired, and are historic instances retained?
Which code scheme is used, at what code length, and what ground area does that length resolve?
Is the scheme openly specified and reversible without a proprietary service, or does resolution depend on a vendor?
How does the code relate to the underlying coordinate reference system and to any civic address for the same place?
Where no civic address exists, what governs the use of the code as the operative location reference?
Which identifier designates the point of interest independently of its operator, brand and current name?
Which category taxonomy classifies the POI, at which level, and which alternate categories also apply?
What is the operating status of the POI, and when was it last confirmed?
How does the POI resolve to one or more addresses, to a building or unit, and to a brand?
What existence confidence is asserted, on what evidence, and what threshold gates publication?
Which named place does this toponym name, and is the same name borne by other places within the same scope?
In which language and script is each name form recorded, and which forms are romanisations of which source form?
Which form is officially standardised by the national names authority, and which are endonyms, exonyms or historic forms?
How are contested, reinstated or superseded names recorded without erasing prior forms?
Which name form should a consumer display for a stated audience locale, and what is the fallback?
What normalisation and parsing steps precede matching, and against which reference dataset version was the match run?
What match score, match type and matched component set does the operation return?
Which score threshold accepts a match automatically, and what routes a candidate to human review?
Is the result stored as an attribute of the address or as a separate derived observation with its own timestamp and inputs?
How are ambiguous, partial and interpolated results represented rather than silently resolved to one answer?
Which quality tests does this record pass or fail, and against which rule set version were they run?
What anomaly status applies when the address is not correct under its governing reference system, and may it still be used?
Who is notified of a defect, within what period must it be resolved, and what status applies meanwhile?
What evidence is retained to show that a test was executed against a specific record version?
Is the validation rule set published so that consumers can check records before submitting them?
From which source dataset and source record did each attribute of this record derive?
What are the source update time, the ingestion time and the real-world event time for each contributed attribute, and where do they diverge?
Which contributor holds rights in each contributed attribute, and does that constrain redistribution of the merged record?
When two sources conflict on the same attribute, which precedence rule decides, and is the rejected value retained?
What confidence does each source attach to its own assertion, and how is that combined into the published record?
Under what licence may this dataset be used, redistributed and built upon, and does the licence differ by component?
Which components are encumbered by a third-party licence that blocks open publication of the merged whole?
Does a statutory duty to publish spatial data override or coexist with a commercial licence here?
What attribution, share-alike or field-of-use restriction attaches to geocodes derived from this data?
At what point does this location reference become personal data, and which linkage causes that?
Which records are suppressed or coarsened for safety, by whose decision, and for how long?
What precision reduction applies when publishing a sensitive position, and is the reduction reversible from published data?
How long are retired addresses, assignment records and matching logs retained, and what is hard-deleted versus tombstoned?
What lawful-access route allows emergency services or another authorised party to reach a suppressed record?
To which external address or location models is this register crosswalked, at which versions, and where is each mapping lossy?
What evidence supports each claimed conformance class, and was a conformance test actually executed?
Which encoding projections are published, and are they all derived from a single canonical record?
Which fields does each projection drop or default, and is that projection therefore non-authoritative?
How is a component with no target in the receiving model conveyed without silent loss?

grok_only.name: Is this record a civic, postal, landmark, service or mixed address, and which national or application profile of ISO 19160-1 does it implement?
Which alternative or legacy identifiers must be retained for interoperability with existing systems without treating a date as an identifier?
Which register is the identifier master, and may a consuming Dimension mint a UUID only after that master is shown to be absent?
Which administrative units, address area, thoroughfare, locators and postal descriptors constitute this address, and in what combination rule?
What is the complete full-address string, in which language and script, and is it intended for display, print or both?
Which structure, wing, floor, unit, room, section, row or seat locators further specify this civic location without implying an indoor topology model?
Does the governing profile require an administrative unit at country level, as INSPIRE does, and what ISO 3166-1 value is used?
What is the current status, real-world valid-from and valid-to, and database lifespan-version timestamps, each in RFC 3339 with seconds and an explicit offset or Z?
Which aliases, former numbers or multilingual forms must continue to resolve to this address without minting a new master identifier?
What was the real-world event time of the status change, and what was the distinct observation or ingestion time?
If retired, is the identifier retained as history, and under what explicit reassignment event may it be bound to a different object?
What is the master thoroughfare identifier, official name parts, language and thoroughfare kind?
Are section, branch, sub-branch or pre/post-modifiers required to disambiguate this thoroughfare in the local civic scheme?
When was this thoroughfare renamed, what former names remain aliases, and which addresses were affected without automatically changing their master identifiers?
Is a centreline, linear-reference axis or other extent recorded for mapping, and in which CRS, without turning this record into a transport-network product?
Which ISO 19160-4 segments, constructs and elements are populated, and is an addressee or mailee stored as postal data rather than as a party master?
Which country template, line-selection conditions and space constraints produce the rendered postal lines?
Is the delivery target a post office box or other non-site delivery point, and is a separate civic or service address required for physical location?
Has an emergency-location profile rejected this postal form, and if so which civic or service address replaces it?
Which addressable object is currently bound to this address, of what object type, and is the bind 1:1, 1:n or n:1?
Which organisation holds the addressing mandate, under which instrument, and which address reference system encodes local numbering and naming rules?
What assignment, component-change, reassignment or retirement event occurred, at what event time, on what basis, and at what distinct ingestion time?
Have address-component signs been installed or updated in the physical world as part of the ISO 19160-2 process, and who is responsible for that installation?
What are the coordinate values, including any height or depth, and in which CRS are they expressed?
What uncertainty or precision is claimed, by which method, and at what observation time distinct from ingestion time?
Is a geo URI or other compact encoding published, and does it use the WGS-84 default or an explicitly registered crs parameter?
How many geocodes of differing precision, method or CRS are attached to the same address or gazetteer location, and which is the default geographic position?
Which CRS identifier and register authority interpret this geocode, and is that CRS spatial, engineering, dynamic, parametric, temporal or compound?
If the CRS is dynamic, what coordinate epoch applies, and must the geocode be revised as crustal motion accumulates?
Which coordinate operation transforms this value to the exchange CRS used for comparison, and who is responsible for applying it?
Is this an engineering CRS for a site or a CRS on a moving platform, and to which Earth-fixed CRS does it relate?
Which geographic-identifier scheme and value designate this location, and is the value a label, a postcode, a grid code or another code type?
Does the code represent an area rather than a point, and what is the implied cell size or plus-code length?
Is this identifier used because no civic address exists, and what is the relationship to any later-assigned civic address?
Which linear object, typically a thoroughfare axis, is the reference, and what identifier and direction apply?
What measure, unit and start referent locate the point or event along that object?
What offset, side and unit place the address relative to the linear object, for example building set-back from centreline?
Is this linear location documentation of an existing civic address, or a substitute where no locator designator exists?
What is the location-instance identifier, location type and geographic identifier, and which gazetteer authority maintains it?
Is position recorded as description, complementary coordinates, both, or neither, and in which CRS if coordinates exist?
Is a governed URI from a names register published for this location, and how does it relate to the address identifier if both exist?
Which ISO 19112 spatial reference system using geographic identifiers defines the parent locations and location types for this gazetteer?
What is the standardised endonym, in which language and script, and which national names authority issued it?
Which exonyms and romanised forms are published, under which romanisation system, and which are preferred for international exchange?
Is the name official, historical or deprecated, and from when to when, without using the date as the name identifier?
Does this toponym name a settlement, thoroughfare, POI, hydrologic feature or other gazetteer type, and is homonym disambiguation required?
What identifier and primary name identify this point of interest, and is it a gazetteer location instance rather than a separate product class?
What category vocabulary and value apply, what is the operating status, and is that vocabulary locally governed rather than ISO-standard?
Which address, geocode or gazetteer location situates the POI, and may it resolve to more than one address?
Is a subject owner authorised to create or update this listing, under what publication agreement, and who remains the gazetteer authority?
Against which dataset or record scope, product specification and intended use was quality evaluated?
What completeness, logical consistency, positional accuracy, temporal quality, thematic accuracy and usability results were obtained?
When was the evaluation performed, by which method, and is the result still current relative to subsequent updates?
Does the consumer impose a minimum quality threshold that ISO 19160-3 itself does not define, and is that threshold recorded as a local constraint?
Which source profile stores the record and which target profile does the consumer require?
Which documented conflicts apply, including civic versus postal versus emergency service address, missing country component, or indoor locators absent from a postal template?
Is conversion lossless, lossy or not-mappable, and which elements would be dropped or invented if conversion proceeded?
Is any conformance claim limited to alignment, or is there evidence of passing an abstract test suite such as INSPIRE or ISO 19160-4?
Is this record in the public gazetteer projection, restricted, emergency-only or private, and which licence covers public release?
What coordinate precision or uncertainty is published to non-privileged consumers, and is the full-precision value retained under a tighter scope?
Does the record contain addressee, mailee, telephone or other personal data in the postal sense, and which data-protection regime applies?
On withdrawal, is the address retired and retained as history, or is a legal erasure of personal or precise-location data required, and what audit is kept?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
